result.instructions: Tools for Formbricks, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Formbricks data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run formbricks_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run formbricks_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run formbricks_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. formbricks_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: formbricks_health
tools.title: Check API health
tools.description: Check that the Formbricks API is reachable. Formbricks v2: GET /health.

tools.name: formbricks_whoami
tools.title: Identify the configured key
tools.description: Return the project and environment the configured x-api-key belongs to — the fastest way to find the workspace and environment ids the other tools need. Formbricks v2: GET /me.

tools.name: formbricks_list_responses
tools.title: List survey responses
tools.description: List survey responses, optionally narrowed to one survey, one contact or a date window. This is the main read: the answers people gave. Formbricks v2: GET /management/responses.

startDate.description: ISO-8601 lower bound on the date field.

endDate.description: ISO-8601 upper bound on the date field.

filterDateField.description: Which date field the window applies to.

skip.description: How many records to skip (offset paging).

sortBy.description: Field to sort on, e.g. createdAt or updatedAt.

tools.name: formbricks_get_response
tools.title: Get one response
tools.description: Fetch a single survey response with its answers, metadata and completion state. Formbricks v2: GET /management/responses/{id}.

tools.name: formbricks_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks configured to fire on survey events, optionally filtered to specific surveys. Formbricks v2: GET /management/webhooks.

surveyIds.description: Only webhooks bound to these survey ids.

skip.description: How many records to skip (offset paging).

sortBy.description: Field to sort on, e.g. createdAt or updatedAt.

tools.name: formbricks_get_webhook
tools.title: Get one webhook
tools.description: Fetch a single webhook with its URL, triggers and bound surveys. Formbricks v2: GET /management/webhooks/{id}.

tools.name: formbricks_list_contact_attribute_keys
tools.title: List contact attribute keys
tools.description: List the contact attribute keys defined in an environment — the schema of what you know about a contact. Formbricks v2: GET /management/contact-attribute-keys.

skip.description: How many records to skip (offset paging).

sortBy.description: Field to sort on, e.g. createdAt or updatedAt.

tools.name: formbricks_get_contact_attribute_key
tools.title: Get one contact attribute key
tools.description: Fetch a single contact attribute key. Formbricks v2: GET /management/contact-attribute-keys/{id}.

tools.name: formbricks_get_survey_contact_link
tools.title: Get a personal survey link for a contact
tools.description: Get the personalised survey URL for one contact — the link you send so their response is attributed to them. Formbricks v2: GET /management/surveys/{surveyId}/contact-links/contacts/{contactId}/.

contact_id.description: The contact the link is for.

annotations.title: Get a personal survey link for a contact

tools.name: formbricks_get_survey_segment_links
tools.title: Get personal survey links for a segment
tools.description: Get personalised survey URLs for every contact in a segment — how you run a targeted send. Formbricks v2: GET /management/surveys/{surveyId}/contact-links/segments/{segmentId}.

skip.description: How many records to skip (offset paging).

annotations.title: Get personal survey links for a segment

tools.name: formbricks_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List the teams in an organisation. Formbricks v2: GET /organizations/{organizationId}/teams.

skip.description: How many records to skip (offset paging).

sortBy.description: Field to sort on, e.g. createdAt or updatedAt.

tools.name: formbricks_list_organization_users
tools.title: List organisation users
tools.description: List the users in an organisation, optionally looked up by id or email. Formbricks v2: GET /organizations/{organizationId}/users.

email.description: Only the user with this email.

id.description: Only the user with this id.

skip.description: How many records to skip (offset paging).

tools.name: formbricks_list_roles
tools.title: List roles
tools.description: List the roles that can be assigned to organisation users. Formbricks v2: GET /roles.

tools.name: formbricks_create_webhook
tools.title: Create a webhook
tools.description: Register a webhook that fires on survey events. Formbricks v2: POST /management/webhooks.

url.description: The HTTPS URL Formbricks should POST to.

workspaceId.description: The workspace the webhook belongs to.

surveyIds.description: Surveys the webhook covers. Pass an empty array for all surveys.

tools.name: formbricks_delete_webhook
tools.title: Delete a webhook
tools.description: Remove a webhook. Formbricks v2: DELETE /management/webhooks/{id}.

tools.name: formbricks_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Create a contact in a workspace from a set of attributes, e.g. email and userId. Formbricks v2: POST /management/contacts.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to create the contact in.

tools.name: formbricks_delete_response
tools.title: Delete a response
tools.description: Delete one survey response. Irreversible — use it to honour a data-deletion request. Formbricks v2: DELETE /management/responses/{id}.
